order: As one of the over-age players in South Korea's under-23 team, he has missed Celtic matches, including both games in the derby double-header against Rangers.
Yang was named in the matchday squad but did not play. He had missed the quarter-final victory over Vietnam after suffering a hamstring injury, and later said he hoped to return.
Celtic winger Yang remained on the bench as South Korea reached the Asian Games final with a 2-1 win over China.

South Korea will learn their final opponents later, with Uzbekistan and Japan meeting in the other semi-final. Yang will hope to feature before returning to Scotland. He remains unavailable for Celtic until then.
South Korea fell behind when Yudong Wang scored, but Young-Jun Lee equalised ten minutes later. Bae Junho completed the comeback with the winning goal in the 82nd minute.
